cases.description: 200 scripted UI cycles over the real SF_Telem root (over the fake serial transport) with a per-action Dear ImGui balance oracle: serial closed/open/lost through the production chain, the REAL Navigation buttons and homescreen tile (ImGui item activation), replay open + the REAL Unload button, the REAL Browse button opening the native IFileDialog cancelled by a helper thread, minimize/restore, resize, F11 fullscreen (real hotkey) both ways, and undocking a docked window through ImGui's own undock path. After EVERY action: zero recovered ImGui errors, zero end-of-frame stack leaks, zero context/font drift, per-layer depths balanced. Exact action log + screenshots saved.

200 scripted UI cycles in the real Starforge editor: every viewport-strip chip (snap Move/Rotate/Scale, Grid, Colliders, World/Local) clicked through Dear ImGui mouse events at the probed rects and confirmed to toggle, built-in layout presets (dock/undock churn), viewport hide/show, Play start/stop, minimize/restore, resize and F11 fullscreen (real hotkey). After EVERY action: zero recovered ImGui errors, zero end-of-frame leaks, zero context drift, strip and per-chip colour-stack deltas zero (the KI-1 mechanism). Action log + screenshots saved.
